product_metadata.title: Boperzi Toothbrush Holder 3 Slots and Toothpaste Tube Squeezer Dispenser 4 Colors, White Electric Toothbrush Multifutional Organizer Tube Rollers Bulk for Shower Bathroom
features: ✔MODERN & DURABLE: The outer wave pattern of the toothbrush and toothpaste holder is smooth.The simple and stylish design is suitable for kids bathroom decor and other various style for adult. The white toothbrush holder is made of high quanlity food-grade PP material. It have no peculiar smell. This anti-rust toothbrush stand organizer is very sturdy, You don't have to worry whether it's fragile or scratching the counter top.

✔EASY USE & NO WASTE: The portable reusable tube rollers has four different colors, yellow, pink, blue and white. The tube saver is suitable for squeezeing tubes whose width does not exceed 2.36 inches. It can easily slide on the tube to help you fully extrude out the paste without wasting any bit.

✔IDEAL SIZE & CLASSIFIED STORAGE: The size of the tooth brush caddy is: ５.９８*３.０７*４.４１inch. It's divided into 3 slots, which can effectively help you distinguish the space of tooth brushes, electric toothbrushes and toothpastes, classified store your bathroom stuffs and make your countertop neat and tidy.

✔WIDELY APPLICATION: This not only can storage toothbrushes and tooth paste. It can also store and protect your tongue cleaner, power brush, razor, facial cleanser, comb, eyebrow trimmer, etc..This multifunctional shelf saves space and prevent your restroom or kitchen from chaos.The small tube squeezer can be used for squeezing tube of hand cream, paint, portable condensed milk, polygel and other tube paste at home.

✔DETACHABLE & EASY TO INSTALL: The toothbrush organization is removable and easy to clean.The toothpaste tube slider is easy to install on the tube that needs to be squeezed. As long as the end seal of the tube tail is passed through the gap in the middle of the squeezer from the back to the front, it can start to work.
